header: Former members, their years and where they went
lead: The child's role carries the years and its text carries the current position, so a row reads as a sentence from left to right: face, name, years, destination.
note: The note under the list is for the sentence about the list itself — who is missing, and how somebody asks to be added or removed.

people.title: The name comes first
people.text: Then the years, then the line about where they went.

people.title: Rules, not gaps
people.text: A rule under each row keeps a column reading as one list.

people.title: The years stay plain text
people.text: A range is not a machine-readable datetime, so it is not marked up as one.

people.title: Compact halves the row
people.text: Smaller avatar, tighter padding, same three facts.
